description: This file contains unit tests for the Role class in the OpenMRS API, specifically testing role privileges, role hierarchy, and related behaviors.

classes.name: RoleTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class for testing Role-related methods such as privilege management and role hierarchies in OpenMRS.

methods.name: shouldAddRemovePrivilege
methods.description: Tests adding and removing privileges from a Role object, including edge cases like null and duplicate privileges.

methods.name: hasPrivilege_shouldNotFailGivenNullParameter
methods.description: Verifies that calling hasPrivilege with null does not cause an error.

methods.name: hasPrivilege_shouldReturnTrueIfFound
methods.description: Checks that a role correctly recognizes when it has a specific privilege.

methods.name: hasPrivilege_shouldReturnFalseIfNotFound
methods.description: Ensures that a role correctly reports absence of a privilege it does not have.

methods.name: hasPrivilege_shouldBeCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Tests that privilege name matching is case-insensitive.

methods.name: hasPrivilege_shouldReturnTrueForAnyPrivilegeNameIfSuperUser
methods.description: Verifies that the superuser role has all privileges regardless of name.

methods.name: getAllParentRoles_shouldOnlyReturnParentRoles
methods.description: Tests the accuracy of the method retrieving all ancestor roles in a hierarchy.

methods.name: getAllChildRoles_shouldOnlyReturnChildRoles
methods.description: Tests the accuracy of the method retrieving all descendant roles in a hierarchy.
